long_biography.plain_text:
Bluebell began when Peter Goemans opened a perfume shop on the French Riviera and started introducing European luxury goods to Asian consumers. When his son Michel took the helm in 1967, Catherine joined him. Together they pioneered premium fashion boutiques and built networks across Hong Kong, Singapore and Guam, creating launch platforms for European labels.

Catherine remained publicly identified as a Bluebell owner as the family group expanded through wholesale distribution, mono-brand stores, travel retail and partnerships with global fashion houses. Their daughter Sophie later joined the business, extending the succession into a third generation. Her role was both familial and operational: she entered an established platform, helped shape its Asian retail model and shared ownership of the enterprise.
